name: per-search-title-key-performance
hypothesis: Compute title match counts once per shared document and sort indices by those keys, preserving descending match count/updatedAt and ascending ID, stable equal-key input order, source bounds and privacy. Avoid title tokenization/match counting inside every comparison.
timingQuerySelection: Seven original dev query IDs with lexicographically lowest SHA256(id UTF8), selected without inspecting new timings.

timing.configuration: Optimized Release Mac standalone production-logic executable; current compiler/OS retained
timing.warmup: Every selected query once per process before the measured pass
timing.measure: RecordRetrieval.candidates only, over complete3633-record corpus, input loaded before timer; signature generation outside timer. No model inference/UI/provider work.
timing.gate: At least20% lower median preparation time across all21 measured queries, and no per-query three-run median regression above10%. Record every run, not only best timings. No exception to output equivalence.
timing.limitations: Warmed Mac Release preparation is not cold-start, whole-app, physical-iPhone, energy or worst-case resource behavior. Concurrent unrelated activity is not controlled or stopped.

correctness: Every measured warm/timed index must have equal full ordered-row/keyword-ranking/source signature before and after; no index exclusions.

Actual full native replay must retain all324 public dev and32 frozen synthetic per-query/per-policy source packets, offsets/fingerprints/methods/statuses/metrics exactly against published compact baseline. This remains development-only; no held-out scores.
Run current package logic, actual pinned original MiniLM checks and meaningful new title-priority/freshness/limit regressions. Preserve all prior identifier/privacy/history/bounds behavior.

Verify all five simulator products, unsigned iOS Release and current native regular built-in literal lookup/follow-up/withdrawal/source/relaunch flow. No UI/layout change is proposed, so no new decorative/design round.
storage: Reuse the one package scratch and existing score/config inputs. Use one appropriate Xcode build directory per platform; publish source/useful compact evidence before stopped-worker cleanup. Preserve supplied skill, current research inputs, primary/Watch/shared runtimes and unrelated data.
